【原视频简介】
Can Senku’s miracle chemical actually break solid rock, or is it just anime logic? 
‎
‎In Part 2 of our Dr. Stone science series, we take on one of the most iconic recipes from the anime: the Revival Fluid (Nital solution). I’ll be synthesizing three different concentrations (5%, 15%, and full-strength 30%) step-by-step using concentrated nitric acid and pure ethanol, navigating the violent exothermic risks along the way.
‎
‎Once the fluid is ready, we put it to the ultimate test against real rocks and calcite minerals to see if real-world chemistry matches the de-petrification science from the show!
‎
‎⚠️ DISCLAIMER: Nitric acid and ethanol mixtures (Nital) are highly corrosive, toxic, and volatile. This experiment was performed with proper chemical safety protocols and protective gear. Do not attempt to replicate this at home.
‎
‎🔔 Subscribe for more real-life anime science experiments!
‎
‎What Dr. Stone invention or chemical reaction should we test next? Let me know in the comments below!
‎
